title: OAuth token refresh rotation
text: Our OAuth access tokens expire after an hour and users get logged out mid-session. How should we refresh them?

title: OAuth token refresh rotation
text: The refresh token rotation flow needs a single-flight guard so concurrent 401 responses do not each start a refresh and invalidate each other.

title: OAuth token refresh rotation
text: Implement refreshAccessToken in src/auth/token.ts. Keep one in-flight refresh promise, retry the original request once, and persist the rotated refresh token.

title: OAuth token refresh rotation
text: bash {"command":"rg refreshAccessToken src/auth/token.ts"}

title: API rate limiter middleware
text: Clients are hammering the /api/export endpoint and starving everyone else. Add a rate limiter.

title: API rate limiter middleware
text: A fixed window is simplest but allows a burst at the boundary; a token bucket matches the existing config shape and smooths bursts.

title: API rate limiter middleware
text: Add a RateLimiter token-bucket middleware keyed by API key in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts; return 429 with a Retry-After header when the bucket is empty.

title: API rate limiter middleware
text: edit {"filePath":"src/middleware/rateLimit.ts"}

title: Playwright chromium deps on Debian
text: visual-shot fails with 'Host system is missing dependencies to run browsers'. How do I provision Chromium?

title: Playwright chromium deps on Debian
text: Run npx playwright install-deps chromium, or unpack the sysroot without root. The usual missing libraries are libnss3, libatk, and libgbm.

title: Playwright chromium deps on Debian
text: bash {"command":"npx playwright install-deps chromium"}

title: Release workflow notes range
text: The generated release notes for the monorepo include another tool's pull requests. How do we pin the range?

title: Release workflow notes range
text: Pass --notes-start-tag with the previous session-search-v tag to gh release create --generate-notes so the range starts at the same package's release.

title: Release workflow notes range
text: bash {"command":"gh release create session-search-v0.2.0 --generate-notes --notes-start-tag session-search-v0.1.0"}

title: SQLite database is locked under load
text: We see 'database is locked' when two writers run at the same time.

title: SQLite database is locked under load
text: WAL allows concurrent readers with one writer; a busy timeout makes writers retry instead of failing immediately.

title: SQLite database is locked under load
text: Enable WAL mode, set busy_timeout to 5000 ms, and serialize writes behind a single writer connection.

title: Render Mermaid diagrams to PNG
text: I want to paste a Mermaid flowchart into a pull request description.

title: Render Mermaid diagrams to PNG
text: Use visual-shot diagram docs/flow.mmd --format png; fenced mermaid blocks inside Markdown are rendered too.

title: Render Mermaid diagrams to PNG
text: bash {"command":"visual-shot diagram docs/flow.mmd --out tmp/flow.png"}

title: Locale-aware date formatting
text: Dates render as MM/DD/YYYY for European users.

title: Locale-aware date formatting
text: Use Intl.DateTimeFormat with the user's locale instead of manual string formatting in src/format/date.ts.

title: Locale-aware date formatting
text: edit {"filePath":"src/format/date.ts"}

title: Dashboard query is slow
text: The dashboard takes 8 seconds to load.

title: Dashboard query is slow
text: It runs one query per widget in a loop, an N+1 pattern, and each query scans the events table.

title: Dashboard query is slow
text: Batch the widget queries into one round trip and add an index on events.dashboard_id.

title: Cache npm dependencies in CI
text: CI reinstalls dependencies on every run and is slow.

title: Cache npm dependencies in CI
text: Use actions/cache keyed on the package-lock hash, or setup-node's cache: npm, in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

title: Cache npm dependencies in CI
text: edit {"filePath":".github/workflows/ci.yml"}

title: Dark mode flashes on load
text: The page flashes white before dark mode applies.

title: Dark mode flashes on load
text: Set the theme class in an inline script before hydration and read localStorage synchronously so the first paint is already dark.

title: Stripe webhook signature verification
text: Payment webhooks are being spoofed. How do we verify them?

title: Stripe webhook signature verification
text: Verify the Stripe-Signature header with the endpoint secret in verifyWebhookSignature in src/billing/webhook.ts before trusting the payload.

title: Stripe webhook signature verification
text: edit {"filePath":"src/billing/webhook.ts"}

title: CORS preflight failing
text: The browser blocks our API calls with a CORS error on OPTIONS.

title: CORS preflight failing
text: The preflight fails because Access-Control-Allow-Origin is missing; allow the origin and the Authorization header in the gateway config.

title: CORS preflight failing
text: edit {"filePath":"src/server/cors.ts"}

title: Flaky test retries
text: One test randomly fails and passes when I rerun it.

title: Flaky test retries
text: The test shares a database fixture with another test running in parallel.

title: Flaky test retries
text: Isolate the fixture per test and mark the suite serial; only retry network-bound tests.

title: Node memory leak in worker pool
text: Our worker process grows until it is killed.

title: Node memory leak in worker pool
text: The pool keeps finished worker objects referenced; clear the pool entry on exit and remove the listener in src/worker/pool.ts.

title: Node memory leak in worker pool
text: edit {"filePath":"src/worker/pool.ts"}

title: Large file upload streaming
text: Uploads over 100 MB time out.

title: Large file upload streaming
text: Stream the request body to disk instead of buffering it in memory, and raise the proxy body limit.

title: Large file upload streaming
text: bash {"command":"rg bodyParser src/server"}

title: Reduce Docker image size
text: The image is 2 GB and slow to pull.

title: Reduce Docker image size
text: Use a multi-stage build, a slim base, and combine the install layers; run docker build with --no-cache to confirm.

title: Reduce Docker image size
text: bash {"command":"docker build --no-cache -t app ."}
